summary: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA).
takeaways: LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction on almost every MulTaBench dataset.
We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models.
These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA).
